toolkit.name: Canva
toolkit.description: Canva offers a drag-and-drop design suite for creating social media graphics, presentations, and marketing materials with prebuilt templates and a vast element library

tools.name: Access user specific brand templates list
tools.description: Lists brand templates available to users on plans with brand-template access, such as Canva Pro, Canva Teams, or Canva Enterprise. Returns one page of template metadata, including IDs and titles. Follow the response's continuation token to retrieve additional pages. Dataset definitions are available from CANVA_RETRIEVE_BRAND_TEMPLATE_DATASET_DEFINITION.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The number of brand templates to return (1-100, default 25).

query.title: Query
query.description: Lets you search the brand templates available to the user using a search term or terms.

dataset.title: DatasetEnm
dataset.description: Filter the list of brand templates based on the brand templates' dataset definitions. Brand templates with dataset definitions are mainly used with the Autofill APIs. This can be one of the following: - `any`: (Default) Brand templates with and without dataset definitions. - `non_empty`: Brand templates with one or more data fields defined.

sort_by.title: SortByEnm
sort_by.description: Sort the list of brand templates. This can be one of the following: - `relevance`: (Default) Sort results using a relevance algorithm. - `modified_descending`: Sort results by the date last modified in descending order. - `modified_ascending`: Sort results by the date last modified in ascending order. - `title_descending`: Sort results by title in descending order. - `title_ascending`: Sort results by title in ascending order.

ownership.title: OwnershipEnm
ownership.description: Filter the list of brand templates based on the user"s ownership of the brand templates. This can be one of the following: - `any`: (Default) Brand templates owned by and shared with the user. - `owned`: Brand templates owned by the user. - `shared`: Brand templates shared with the user.

continuation.title: Continuation
continuation.description: If the success response contains a continuation token, the user has access to more brand templates you can list. You can use this token as a query parameter and retrieve more templates from the list, for example `/v1/brand-templates?continuation={continuation}`. To retrieve all the brand templates available to the user, you might need to make multiple requests. IMPORTANT: This token is an opaque value returned by the API. You must use it exactly as returned from a previous API response. Do not manually construct or modify continuation tokens.

tools.name: Create Asset Upload Job
tools.description: Uploads an asset file to the user's Canva content library. This endpoint initiates an asynchronous upload job for images or videos. Returns a job ID to track the upload progress. Once complete, the asset can be used in designs, referenced by its asset ID, and managed through other asset endpoints. IMPORTANT: This is an async operation. Use CANVA_FETCH_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB_STATUS to poll the job status until it reaches 'success' or 'failed' status.

input.title: CreateAssetUploadJobRequest

file.title: FileUploadable

name.title: Name
name.description: The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service

s3key.title: S3Key
s3key.description: The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service.

mimetype.title: Mimetype
mimetype.description: The MIME type of the file

file.description: Image or video file to upload directly to Canva. Direct upload is the path for large files and for videos larger than the URL-upload limit. No duplicate detection: uploading the same file creates a new asset.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for the asset (maximum 50 characters). The name can be changed later with the Update asset API.

input.description:
Request schema to upload an asset to a user's content library.

Canva expects an application/octet-stream body and an Asset-Upload-Metadata
header containing the upload metadata.

tools.name: Create canva design with optional asset (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use CANVA_POST_DESIGNS instead. Creates a new Canva design with specified dimensions or from an asset. This endpoint creates a design using either a preset type (doc, email, presentation, whiteboard), custom dimensions, or by importing an image asset. Returns the design ID, URLs for editing and viewing, owner info, and metadata. The design can be immediately accessed and edited.

input.title: CreateCanvaDesignWithOptionalAssetRequest

title.title: Title
title.description: Design title (1-255 chars). Appears in Canva UI and design lists.

asset_id.title: Asset Id
asset_id.description: Image asset ID to create design from. Optional if design_type provided. IMPORTANT: Only image assets are supported - video and PDF assets will be rejected by the API with error 'asset_id must belong to an image asset'. Asset IDs are opaque strings with no guaranteed format. To verify an asset is an image before using it here, call CANVA_RETRIEVE_ASSET_METADATA_BY_ID and check that the 'type' field equals 'image'. To upload a new image asset, use CANVA_CREATE_URL_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB or CANVA_CREATE_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB.

design_type.title: Design Type

input.description:
Request schema for `CreateCanvaDesignWithOptionalAsset`

Conditional requirements:
- At least one of 'design_type' or 'asset_id' must be provided.
- When 'design_type.type' = 'preset', 'design_type.name' must be one of: doc, email, whiteboard, presentation.
- 'asset_id' ONLY supports IMAGE assets. Video/PDF assets will be rejected by the API.

IMPORTANT: Before passing an asset_id, use CANVA_RETRIEVE_ASSET_METADATA_BY_ID to verify
the asset's 'type' field equals 'image'. Asset IDs are opaque strings - there is no way
to determine asset type from the ID format alone.

You can either provide a preset/custom design_type or create from an image asset.

tools.name: Create design comment in preview api (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use CANVA_POST_DESIGNS_DESIGNID_COMMENTS instead. Creates a new comment thread on a Canva design using Canva's deprecated Create comment API. This preview API allows adding text comments to designs for collaboration and feedback. Returns the created comment with ID, author info, and timestamp. Comments can be replied to using the comment reply endpoint.

message.title: Message
examples: Great design! Love the color scheme.
message.description: Comment text (1-2048 chars). Mention users with [user_id:team_id]. No markdown support. Comments appear unpinned - users must view 'All pages' to see them.

design_id.title: Design Id
design_id.description: Design ID to attach comment to

assignee_id.title: Assignee Id
assignee_id.description: User ID to assign this comment to. If provided, you must also mention this user in the message text using format [user_id:team_id].

type.title: Type
type.description: Type of target (always 'design' for design-level comments)

design_id.title: Design Id
design_id.description: Design ID to attach comment to

tools.name: Create Design Import Job
tools.description: Imports an external file as a new Canva design. This endpoint converts documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and design files (PSD, AI) into editable Canva designs. The import runs asynchronously and returns a job ID to track progress and retrieve the created design. IMPORTANT: This is an async operation. Use CANVA_RETRIEVE_DESIGN_IMPORT_JOB_STATUS to poll the job status until it reaches 'success' or 'failed' to get the final design ID.

input.title: CreateDesignImportJobRequest

file.title: FileUploadable

name.title: Name
name.description: The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service

s3key.title: S3Key
s3key.description: The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service.

mimetype.title: Mimetype
mimetype.description: The MIME type of the file

file.description: Document or design file to import. Supported formats: AI, PSD, Affinity (.af, .afdesign, .afphoto, .afpub), Keynote, Numbers, Pages, XLS/XLSX, PPT/PPTX, DOC/DOCX, ODG, ODP, ODS, ODT, and PDF.

title.title: Title
title.description: Title for the imported design (maximum 50 characters). Shows in Canva UI and design lists.

mime_type.title: Mime Type
mime_type.description: Optional MIME type override. It is normalized to a lowercase media type without parameters. If omitted, Canva attempts to detect the file type automatically.

Request schema for starting a Canva design import job.

Canva expects the binary file in the request body (application/octet-stream)

tools.name: Create Design Resize Job
tools.description: Creates a resized copy of an existing design (Canva Pro/Enterprise only). This endpoint creates a new design with different dimensions from an existing one. The resize operation runs asynchronously and preserves content where possible. Returns a job ID to track progress and retrieve the new design once complete. IMPORTANT: This is an async operation. Use CANVA_RETRIEVE_DESIGN_RESIZE_JOB_STATUS to poll the job status until completion to get the resized design ID and access URLs.

input.title: CreateDesignResizeJobRequest

oneOf.title: PresetDesignType

name.title: Name
name.description: Preset resize target: 'whiteboard' or 'presentation'. Canva docs cannot be resize targets.

type.title: Type
type.description: Must be 'preset' for predefined design types

oneOf.description: Preset design type using predefined Canva templates.

oneOf.title: CustomDesignType
oneOf.description: Custom design type with user-specified dimensions.

input.description:
Start an async job to create a resized copy of a design.

Either provide a preset design type or custom dimensions.

tools.name: Create URL Asset Upload Job
tools.description: Tool to create an asynchronous Canva asset import job from a public URL. Use when you need to import an asset into Canva directly from a publicly accessible URL without S3 choreography.

input.title: CreateUrlAssetUploadJobRequest

url.title: Url
url.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL of the file to import (8-2048 characters). Canva rejects non-HTTPS URLs.

input.description: Parameters to start a URL-based asset upload job in Canva.

tools.name: Fetch asset upload job status
tools.description: Polls for asset upload job completion status. Use this after CANVA_CREATE_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB to check the upload progress. Repeatedly call this endpoint until a 'success' or 'failed' status is received to get the final asset ID and metadata. IMPORTANT: This tool is ONLY for direct file upload jobs (CANVA_CREATE_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB). Do NOT use this for URL import jobs created by CANVA_CREATE_URL_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB - those use a different API endpoint. Use CANVA_GET_URL_ASSET_UPLOADS_JOBID to poll URL asset upload job status.

jobId.title: Job Id
jobId.description: The asset upload job ID returned by CANVA_CREATE_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB or CANVA_POST_ASSET_UPLOADS. This is the 'id' field from the job object in the response. IMPORTANT: This tool does NOT work for job IDs from CANVA_CREATE_URL_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB (URL import jobs use a different endpoint - use CANVA_GET_URL_ASSET_UPLOADS_JOBID instead).

tools.name: Fetch current user details
tools.description: Returns the User ID and Team ID associated with the provided access token. Use CANVA_RETRIEVE_USER_PROFILE_DATA to retrieve the user's display name.

tools.name: Fetch design metadata and access information
tools.description: Gets the metadata for a design. This includes owner information, URLs for editing and viewing, and thumbnail information.

designId.title: Design Id
designId.description: The design ID (1-50 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens), for example DAFVztcvd9z.

tools.name: Get design export job result
tools.description: Polls for design export job completion status. Use this after CANVA_CREATE_CANVA_DESIGN_EXPORT_JOB to check the export progress. Call this endpoint repeatedly until the job is complete to receive download links for the exported design pages. Download URLs expire after 24 hours.

tools.name: Get design generation job
tools.description: Retrieve a design generation job created by the same user and integration. Call repeatedly until the returned status reaches `success` or `failed`. The user must have Canva's `design_generation` capability. Jobs expire 24 hours after creation, and only the creating user, integration, and team can retrieve them.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: Public design-generation job ID returned when the job was created.

tools.name: Get design export formats
tools.description: Lists available file formats for exporting a design. Use this to check which export formats (PDF, JPG, PNG, SVG, PPTX, GIF, MP4, HTML bundle, standalone HTML, and CSV) are supported for a specific design.

tools.name: Get URL asset upload job status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the status and result of a URL-based asset upload job. Use this after creating a URL asset upload job to check progress and retrieve the uploaded asset ID when successful.

tools.name: Get URL import job status
tools.description: Polls for URL import job completion status. Use this after creating a URL import job to check the import progress. Repeatedly call this endpoint until a 'success' or 'failed' status is received to get the final imported design ID and metadata.

tools.name: Get user capabilities
tools.description: Lists the API capabilities for the user account associated with the provided access token. Use when you need to check what features are available based on the user's Canva plan.

tools.name: List folder items by type with sorting
tools.description: Lists folder items, including folders, designs, image assets, and brand templates. Brand templates are returned only when explicitly requested in `item_types` and the user's plan supports them. Video assets are currently not returned.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The number of folder items to return (1-100, default 50).

sort_by.title: Sort By
sort_by.description: Sort the list of folder items. This can be one of the following: - `created_ascending`: Sort results by creation date, in ascending order. - `created_descending`: Sort results by creation date, in descending order. - `modified_ascending`: Sort results by the last modified date, in ascending order. - `modified_descending`: (Default) Sort results by the last modified date, in descending order. - `title_ascending`: Sort results by title, in ascending order. The title is either the `name` field for a folder or asset, or the `title` field for a design. - `title_descending`: Sort results by title, in descending order. The title is either the `name` field for a folder or asset, or the `title` field for a design.

folderId.title: Folder Id
folderId.description: The folder ID. Must be a non-empty string. Use 'root' to list items in the root folder.

item_types.title: Item Types
item_types.description: Filter the folder items to only return specified types. The available types are: `brand_template`, `design`, `folder`, and `image`. To filter for more than one item type, provide a comma- delimited list.

pin_status.title: Pin Status
pin_status.description: Filter by pinned status: 'any' returns all items and 'pinned' returns only pinned items.

continuation.title: Continuation
continuation.description: If the success response contains a continuation token, the folder contains more items you can list. You can use this token as a query parameter and retrieve more items from the list, for example `/v1/folders/{folderId}/items?continuation={continuation}`. To retrieve all the items in a folder, you might need to make multiple requests.

tools.name: List User Designs
tools.description: Provides a summary of Canva user designs, includes search filtering, and allows showing both self-created and shared designs with sorting options.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The number of designs to return. Minimum 1, maximum 100, default 25.

query.title: Query
query.description: Lets you search the user"s designs, and designs shared with the user, using a search term or terms.

sort_by.title: SortByEnm
sort_by.description: Sort the list of designs. This can be one of the following: - `relevance`: (Default) Sort results using a relevance algorithm. - `modified_descending`: Sort results by the date last modified in descending order. - `modified_ascending`: Sort results by the date last modified in ascending order. - `title_descending`: Sort results by title in descending order. - `title_ascending`: Sort results by title in ascending order.

ownership.title: OwnershipEnm
ownership.description: Filter the list of designs based on the user"s ownership of the designs. This can be one of the following: - `owned`: Designs owned by the user. - `shared`: Designs shared with the user. - `any`: Designs owned by and shared with the user.

continuation.title: Continuation
continuation.description: If the success response contains a continuation token, the list contains more designs you can list. You can use this token as a query parameter and retrieve more designs from the list, for example `/v1/designs?continuation={continuation}`. To retrieve all of a user"s designs, you might need to make multiple requests. Pass a valid token or omit this parameter entirely. Empty strings are not accepted by the API.

tools.name: Retrieve brand template metadata
tools.description: Retrieves metadata for a brand template. Available to users on plans with brand-template access, such as Canva Pro, Canva Teams, or Canva Enterprise.

tools.name: Retrieve design import job status
tools.description: Polls for design import job completion status. Use this after CANVA_CREATE_DESIGN_IMPORT_JOB to check the import progress. Repeatedly call this endpoint until a 'success' or 'failed' status is received to get the final imported design ID and metadata.

tools.name: Retrieve Design Resize Job Status
tools.description: Retrieves the status and results of a design resize job. Polls for design resize job completion status. Use this after CANVA_CREATE_DESIGN_RESIZE_JOB to check the resize progress. Keep polling until status is 'success' or 'failed'. Successful jobs include the new design ID and temporary access URLs.

input.title: RetrieveDesignResizeJobStatusRequest

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: The resize job ID returned from create resize job endpoint

input.description: Request to get the status of a design resize job.

tools.name: Retrieve folder details by id
tools.description: Gets the name and other details of a folder using a folder's `folderID`.

tools.name: Update folder details by id
tools.description: Updates a folder's details using its `folderID`. Currently, you can only update a folder's name.

name.title: Name
name.description: The folder name, as shown in the Canva UI (1-255 characters).

tools.name: Who Am I
tools.description: Return the identity (display name) of the connected Canva account.

input.title: WhoAmIRequest
input.description: The current connected account's identity. Takes no parameters.
